annotations.title: Companies that have filed to go public

description: List companies with a registration statement on file at the SEC for a first public offering (Form S-1 or F-1), newest filing first. Each item carries the registrant CIK, name, industry code, form, a status (filed, effective, priced, listed, withdrawn, stale) with the rule that set it, the first and latest filing dates, the number of amendments, and the proposed ticker and exchange when the prospectus names them. Filter by name or proposed ticker (q), status, form, blank check companies, and the date of the latest filing. These registrants are not yet listed, so company_lookup does not find them; pass the CIK to pre_ipo_company for figures and offering terms. Confidential draft submissions are not public and are not here.

as_of.description: Knowledge date or timestamp (YYYY-MM-DD or RFC 3339). The answer is what FinancialMD knew at that instant: only facts whose known interval contains as_of. Omit for the current view.

blank_check.description: true = only blank check companies (SIC 6770); false = leave them out.

form.description: S-1 = domestic registrant, F-1 = foreign private issuer.

q.description: Part of the registrant name, or the proposed ticker.

status.description: Comma-separated: filed, effective, priced, listed, withdrawn, stale. Default all.

name: pre_ipo_companies

outputSchema.description: The FinancialMD envelope (docs/API.md section 2): data plus meta (request_id, as_of knowledge time, matched company, coverage, pipeline_version, licence, terms, proof_base). Every numeric value inside data is an object with value, unit, currency, period, known interval, restated flag, method and a proof pointing at the filing. On failure the result is isError with an error object instead.

data.description: { items: [{ id, cik, name, sic_code, sic_description, registration_form, status, status_rule, first_filed, latest_filed, amendments, proposed_ticker, proposed_exchange, is_blank_check, company, known, links }], next_cursor, statuses, note }

error.description: Present only on isError results: the API error code and message plus remedy hints.

meta.description: Request metadata: request_id, as_of, company resolution, coverage, pipeline_version, licence, terms, proof_base.

attribution.description: Citations a source requires on anything shown from the answer.

title: Companies that have filed to go public
